## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and affected boundaries.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure path.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Extension Host, visual, accessibility, localization, security, or
      performance checks were run when relevant.

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, prompts, transcripts, headers,
      payloads, customer data, or generated review artifacts are included.
- [ ] Timeouts or incomplete evidence are not reported as passing results.
- [ ] Public documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
